name: all_claims_verified
description: All claims are directly supported by sources
content: AI is transforming healthcare diagnostics. Machine learning models can detect diseases from medical images with high accuracy. Hospitals are increasingly adopting AI-powered tools for patient triage.

sources.title: AI in Healthcare Report
sources.snippet: AI is transforming healthcare diagnostics by enabling faster and more accurate detection of diseases.

sources.title: ML in Medical Imaging
sources.snippet: Machine learning models can detect diseases from medical images with accuracy rates exceeding 90%.

sources.title: Hospital AI Adoption
sources.snippet: Hospitals are increasingly adopting AI-powered tools for patient triage and workflow optimization.

name: fabricated_statistics
description: Content contains fabricated statistics not in any source
content: According to a 2024 study, 97.3% of Fortune 500 companies have fully deployed AI systems. The global AI market reached $2.7 trillion in Q3 2024. AI reduces operational costs by exactly 83.2% on average.

sources.title: AI Adoption Trends
sources.snippet: Many large enterprises are exploring AI solutions for various business functions.

sources.title: AI Market Report
sources.snippet: The AI market continues to grow, with estimates suggesting significant expansion in the coming years.

name: mixed_verified_and_unsupported
description: Mix of real and fabricated claims
content: Cloud computing adoption is growing rapidly across enterprises. AWS leads the cloud market with significant market share. Notably, quantum cloud services now account for 45% of all cloud revenue, and every major bank has migrated 100% of workloads to the cloud.

sources.title: Cloud Computing Report
sources.snippet: Cloud computing adoption is growing rapidly across enterprises of all sizes.

sources.title: Cloud Market Share
sources.snippet: AWS leads the cloud infrastructure market with approximately 31% market share.

name: contradicted_claims
description: Claims that directly contradict the sources
content: Python is declining in popularity and is rarely used in data science. Most developers prefer Assembly language for machine learning projects.

sources.title: Programming Language Trends
sources.snippet: Python continues to dominate as the most popular language for data science and machine learning.

sources.title: Developer Survey
sources.snippet: Python remains the top choice for ML projects, with 85% of data scientists using it as their primary language.

name: no_sources_available
description: Content exists but no research sources to verify against
content: Blockchain technology is revolutionizing supply chain management by providing transparency and traceability.

name: subtle_exaggeration
description: Claims that subtly exaggerate source material
content: AI completely eliminates all diagnostic errors in hospitals. Every patient who receives AI-assisted care has better outcomes without exception.

sources.title: AI Diagnostics Study
sources.snippet: AI-assisted diagnostics can reduce certain types of diagnostic errors by up to 30% in clinical settings.

sources.title: Patient Outcomes
sources.snippet: Studies show that AI-assisted care can improve patient outcomes in specific scenarios, though results vary by implementation.

name: vague_but_safe_claims
description: Vague general claims that are hard to falsify
content: Technology is changing the way we work. Companies are investing in digital transformation. The future of business involves more automation.

sources.title: Digital Transformation
sources.snippet: Organizations worldwide are investing heavily in digital transformation initiatives.

name: correct_attribution
description: Claims correctly attributed to specific sources
content: According to Gartner, 75% of enterprises will shift from piloting to operationalizing AI by 2024. McKinsey reports that AI could add $13 trillion to the global economy by 2030.

sources.title: Gartner AI Forecast
sources.snippet: Gartner predicts that 75% of enterprises will shift from piloting to operationalizing AI by 2024.

sources.title: McKinsey AI Impact
sources.snippet: McKinsey estimates AI could add approximately $13 trillion to global economic output by 2030.
